name: AI Lead Intake Automation - Make Starter Blueprint
import_note: This blueprint is a documented starter blueprint, not guaranteed to be directly importable into every Make workspace. Recreate or adjust modules in Make if import compatibility differs.

scenario.name: Custom Webhook - Lead Intake
scenario.description: Receives simple external lead data from forms, ads, or other sources.

scenario.name: Normalize Lead Payload
scenario.description: Maps name, email, phone, company, industry, budget, timeline, source, pain_point, and message into the FastAPI lead schema.

scenario.name: Generate Idempotency Key
scenario.description: Creates or maps a stable key for retries of the same lead.

scenario.name: Router - Hot or Qualified vs Normal
Notification Placeholder
scenario.description: Notify a sales team by Slack, email, or another Make module.

scenario.name: Error Handling Route Placeholder
scenario.description: Log failed API requests or notify an operator without exposing secrets.

notes: Make sends the lead to FastAPI.
FastAPI processes the lead with AI.
FastAPI handles downstream Google Sheets, Airtable, and HubSpot dispatch through the app integration dispatcher.
HMAC is optional advanced security and is not implemented in this starter pseudo-blueprint.
